name: Airbus H160
summary: A sleek modern twin-turbine helicopter with a five-blade rotor, canted fenestron tail and swept Blue Edge blade tips.

wings: Five-blade rotor with swept Blue Edge tips
engines: Twin turboshafts in a smooth dorsal cowl
fuselage: Sleek smooth body with a dolphin-like nose

confusedWith.howToTell: The EC155 is boxier with a straight fenestron; the H160 is sleeker with curved blade tips and a canted tail.
The Dauphin has a four-blade rotor and a straight fenestron.
The AW169 has a conventional tail rotor; the H160 has a canted ducted fan.
